messages:
alyssa_support: Customer reports invoice line-items don't match their dashboard — they're seeing ~0.01–0.03 GBP extra per 1k requests after discounts applied. Said invoice shows 3 split lines for the same day, dashboard aggregates as 1. They attached invoice ID INV-2026-09-ACME and sample request ids.

billing-bot: I pulled INV-2026-09-ACME: totals reconcile to our ledger, but I see three separate line_items with tiny fractional GBP values (0.003, 0.012, 0.021) that were rounded to 0.01 on invoice display. Looks like per-request rounding then later discount allocation widened the gap.

liam_engineer: Can you paste a couple of the raw request logs / token counts? need to see exact token rounding code path.

alyssa_support: Pasted logs from customer (redacted):
```
request_id: r-9a7b
model: gpt-redwood-16k
tokens_input: 12.2
tokens_output: 3.8
billable_tokens: 16.0
unit_price_gbp: 0.0008
raw_cost: 0.0128
rounded_cost_display: 0.01
```
Second request same minute: billable_tokens 8.0, raw_cost 0.0064 -> rounded 0.01. Dashboard sums raw_cost at high precision but invoice does per-line display rounding.

jordan_pm: So two problems: (1) display rounding per line can cause invoice amount != dashboard micro-precision; (2) discount allocation algorithm splits discounts across lines and then we re-round, so residuals can become non-zero and sometimes push lines up. We should decide fix vs mitigation. Customer is asking for an immediate credit if totals differ.

carmen_ops: Quick repro idea: 1) generate 10 requests with mixed token counts, 2) apply volume discount (e.g., 5%), 3) aggregate ledger with current pipeline and compare "displayed invoice" totals. I can run this in staging.

liam_engineer: Confirmed a bug in the invoice aggregator: we apply rounding to each allocated-discounted-line before summing for display instead of rounding only at the invoice level. That produces +/- a few pence depending on fragmentation. Patch: defer final rounding until invoice total, carry residuals into a single adjustment line.

alyssa_support: Customer wants: (a) explanation, (b) refund for difference if >0.05 GBP, (c) change to invoice format to show high-precision internal numbers.

billing-bot: Policy: we can issue credit notes for discrepancies > £0.05 without exec sign-off. For smaller amounts we issue a goodwill credit at CS discretion.

jordan_pm: Next steps:
- liam: hotfix to aggregator to roll rounding to invoice-level and add adjustment line (ETA 48h)
- carmen: run batch repro in staging and attach diff report to ticket (ETA 6h)
- alyssa: communicate temporary workaround to customer: show them our dashboard CSV export (full-precision) and offer immediate credit if diff > 0.05 GBP (I'll do the support reply)

liam_engineer: Quick patch diff (staged):
```
- allocated = round(per_line_amount_after_discount, 2)
+ allocated = per_line_amount_after_discount  # keep full precision
# after all allocations
+ invoice_total = round(sum(allocated) , 2)
+ adjustment = invoice_total - sum(allocated)
+ append_adjustment_line(adjustment)
```
This keeps ledger math exact and only rounds at final step. Also need to ensure currency conversion (GBP->EUR) path carries >4 decimals until final rounding.

carmen_ops: Ran staging repro: with 1k mixed requests, old pipeline showed invoice delta £1.23 vs dashboard; new pipeline shows delta £0.00 (display) and adjustment line equals residual -0.01 which matches ledger at high precision. Attaching csv (will add to ticket).

alyssa_support: Customer replied: appreciate quick triage, will accept credit if we issue. Asking if VAT/tax is affected by the adjustment line.

billing-bot: Tax calc: VAT/Tax must be applied to the taxable base. For UK VAT (if applicable) we need to ensure adjustment line has appropriate tax category. If adjustment moves the taxable base, we must recompute tax at invoice-level. I'll flag accounting.

jordan_pm: Action: accounting & legal to sign-off on tax handling for adjustment line. alyssa, offer provisional credit for gross difference and note that final tax adjustment may follow on corrected invoice.

alyssa_support: Replying to customer now: short note with CSV export link, provisional credit offer for the gross diff (£0.12), and timeline for corrected invoice (48–72h). Will escalate to accounting for tax treatment.

liam_engineer: Patch merged to canary. Monitoring for edge cases where multi-currency conversions could still create micro-deltas due to FX rounding rules.

carmen_ops: Added a small test to billing test-suite to prevent per-line rounding regressions and a note to docs about "invoice rounding model".

alyssa_support: Closing loop after accounting confirms VAT handling. Thanks team :raised_hands:

billing-bot: Credit note CN-2026-09-009 issued for INV-2026-09-ACME: 0.12 GBP gross. Accounting will reconcile tax in next invoice.

liam_engineer: FYI: follow-up improvement: make invoice renderer show a tooltip/hover with high-precision components so customers can inspect rounding behavior.

jordan_pm: Sweet, let's push rollout and then proactively scan for invoices with >£0.05 residual to auto-issue credits last 90 days.

alyssa_support: Thanks all — I'll mark the customer ticket as "escalation in progress" and update once accounting confirms.
